fixtures_note: Live captures of Mentor Practice 2 (comp 179) plus synthetic fixtures; see fixture_sources per case.

cases.title: Watch offer, the learner says yes: two focus entries (Door first, then Needle), Needle's place in one sentence, A and Shift+P asked in the turn before the demo (no demo in it), the demo only on Needle, Door handed back with no second walk-through

checks.detail: turn 4: "Needle will turn from the middle of its bottom edge"

rubric.reason: After the yes in Turn 4, the mentor set focus to Door then Needle. It said Needle's place in one sentence ("Needle will turn from the middle of its bottom edge.") and asked for A then Shift+P while running nothing but the snapshot. In Turn 5 it demonstrated on anchor/15 (Needle) only and handed Door back in one sentence with no second walkthrough.

The mentor asked for Needle selected with A then Shift+P, took a frame, ran anchor_demo on Needle, and took a second frame at time 0. It said "Both numbers changed, and Needle didn't move. The two frames before and after look the same, and that's the point" and gave Edit > Undo, with no values and no claim about how the numbers changed.

Turn 5 describes one change in plain words with a real name ("Needle's pivot is now at the middle of its bottom edge"), matching the tool's place bottom-middle. It gives Edit > Undo with no undo label or field names and hands Door to the learner without offering to do it.

Every name and time the mentor used comes from tool output: Door, Needle, Anchor Point, Position, 0 s, Door's pivot at its center (place_now), and Needle's bottom-middle (watch_offer and demo result).

Each turn moves one idea and ends on an action. The opening ends on the Door offer, Turn 2 ends on the A then Shift+P ask with no slide sentence, Turn 3 is the move in prose with the watch offer last, Turn 4 is the place plus the ask, and Turn 5 is the demo result plus Door handed back.
